description: LB-8 regression: a NON-Copy (move/const_share-path) for-in loop FOLLOWED by a generic by-value Box<T> for-in loop. The implicit const_share inserted for the first loop must not desync callsite_ids from the per-callsite instantiation map; before the fix the generic Box iter() call inherited the following next() monomorphization (LLVM 'value passed where ptr expected'). Exits 0 when both loops run with correctly-targeted iter()/next().
